message: I was charged twice for my September subscription - Rs 1,299 taken two times. Please refund one.
The Monsoon Malabar roast is the best coffee I've had outside Coorg. Ordering again!
Order BM-4471 was placed on 14 Sep and still hasn't arrived. Tracking hasn't moved for 6 days.
Bhai grinder ka glass jar crack ho gaya first use mein, ek chhota piece meri coffee mein mila. This is dangerous.
Can you add a decaf option to the subscription? My wife loves your beans but can't have caffeine after 4pm.
App logs me out every time I open it. Had to reset my password three times this week.
Please pause my subscription for October, I'm travelling. Couldn't find a pause button anywhere.
Third time my beans arrived stale - roast date was 5 weeks old. If this isn't fixed I'm posting a full review on YouTube.
Refund for my cancelled order (Rs 849) was promised in 5 days. It's been 12 days.
Love the new packaging! The resealable zip actually works.
Delivery partner left the parcel outside in the rain, the bag was soaked but the beans seem okay.
Coupon FIRSTBREW isn't applying at checkout, it says invalid.
Would you consider a cold brew kit? I'd pay for a monthly cold brew pack in summer.
Grind size 'fine' is way too coarse for my moka pot. Coffee tastes watery.
My subscription renewed even though I cancelled on 20 Sep. I want my money back.
Brewmark's customer care replied in 10 minutes and sorted my address change. Impressed.
The website shows 'out of stock' for Attikan Estate but the app lets me order it. Which is right?
Parcel says delivered but I never got it. Neighbours haven't seen it either.
Could the beans come in 500g bags too? 250g runs out too fast for our office.
Ordered the Chikmagalur sampler as a gift and the note card was missing. Minor, but a bit sad.
